notes.title: The long-awaited release of Sunlight Scream on Steam
notes.notes:
Greetings to all Experimentation fans! I'd like to solemnly present you my main game, which I've been working on for quite a long time, and which was described in one of the Experimentation stories. This is Sunlight Scream itself.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2608440/Sunlight_Scream_University_Massacre/?beta=0

The long-suffering visual novel finally got life on Steam. Get up, student! Study, girls, adventures, and most importantly - a killer in a mask! It's time to work as a detective and find out who is hiding under the mask, without getting under the knife. And preferably save your friends. At least once in a while. 

This is my first game, created entirely on my own and on pure enthusiasm. I put a lot of effort and persistence to make it, and I'm extremely happy that it finally appears on my favorite store - Steam. Looking at the current trend of prices in the store I decided to go against the mainstream - I lowered the price of the game by three times of the planned price. Feel free to add the game to your wishlist, buy it, create content!

And the most important thing at the moment is the release date. Due to Steam restrictions I will be able to release the game not earlier than October 2, so be it.. 

In the meantime, here's some ice cream from Erika!

notes.title: There is a huge pre-release update here!
notes.notes:
Hey, hey, hey! Uploaded a huge update and the game is almost ready for release. We'll be experimenting soon!

- Added and tested Steam achievements
- Improved all images
- Added music and sounds
- Added design
- Added full English localization
- Fixed minor bugs, errors
- Made a new trailer

[previewyoutube=QPNKtQ4CV-o;full][/previewyoutube]
